name: Cancelling a pending request keeps the balance unchanged

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'flow.cancel@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Open the 'Leave Balance' page (URL /balances) and verify the 'Annual Leave' card shows '12/12'.
Open the 'New Request' page (URL /requests/create), select 'Annual Leave', set Start date to 2026-11-20 and End date to 2026-11-21, enter reason 'E2E cancel marker' and click 'Submit request'.
On the request detail page, click the 'Cancel request' button (top right).
The request status shows 'Cancelled' and a message 'The request was cancelled.' is displayed.
The 'Annual Leave' card still shows '12/12' (the balance was never deducted for a pending request).
